keyboard.inputDescription: Waiting for Unity legacy keyboard axes/buttons. Device provenance is declared separately; Unity cannot prove physical key origin. F5 saves actual pose; F6 saves, captures GPU pixels and exits.
keyboard.collisionPolicy: exported original collider geometry reconstructed as static MeshColliders
keyboard.visualPolicy: original mesh geometry, extracted primary colors and supported raw textures; reconstruction shaders, color-space interpretation not independently verified; original body/face and default-active attachments; Standard player materials; original Animator controller/avatar, reconstructed FootL/FootR event collector, root motion disabled, no original game behaviours
keyboard.saveEqualityPolicy: Normalize only IEEE-754 negative zero to positive zero before JSON serialization; every nonzero float bit and every canonical zero bit must survive exactly. Raw negative-zero sign bits are not preserved.

restart.collisionPolicy: exported original collider geometry reconstructed as static MeshColliders
restart.visualPolicy: original mesh geometry, extracted primary colors and supported raw textures; reconstruction shaders, color-space interpretation not independently verified; original body/face and default-active attachments; Standard player materials; original Animator controller/avatar, reconstructed FootL/FootR event collector, root motion disabled, no original game behaviours

limitations: Only original locomotion layer is enabled; ancillary action/clothing/arm/face layers remain at weight zero.
Turning, gravity and Update integration are reconstruction choices; original full gameplay is not implemented.

Signed zero is canonicalized before saving; every nonzero float bit is still checked exactly. The failed first physical run did not record raw zero-sign bits, so its precise affected component cannot be recovered.
Input origin requires separate operator evidence; Unity cannot identify physical hardware by itself.
